services.name: Flight Decks
services.desc: Paragliding flight decks add versatility and capability to your harness. Flight decks offer the ability to add additional instrument space to your cockpit all the way to adding a front mount reserve or second reserve option. From the ultra-light and minimal flight decks to a full front mount reserve container browse our selection of flight decks. Our training season runs from the start of April until mid October. Lessons take place at our training hill in North Boulder every morning, Monday -

blurb: Red Tail Paragliding offers paragliding lessons including a P2 Certification Course and introductory tandem flights. They sell various models of rescue parachutes designed for paragliding safety, emphasizing fast opening times, low sink rates, and lightweight designs. Lessons run seasonally from April 1 to October 15 with flexible scheduling and a minimum of two lessons per week recommended for safe progression.
